properties.name: audio.validation.min-duration-ms
properties.description: Minimum audio duration in milliseconds. Clips shorter than this are rejected to avoid accidental hotkey taps.

properties.name: audio.validation.max-duration-ms
properties.description: Maximum audio duration in milliseconds (5 minutes). Prevents unbounded memory usage.

properties.name: audio.validation.max-file-size-bytes
properties.description: Maximum file size in bytes for audio payloads (100 MB). Security guard against memory exhaustion.

properties.name: audio.capture.chunk-millis
properties.description: Audio buffer chunk size in milliseconds. Smaller values lower latency but increase CPU.

properties.name: audio.capture.max-duration-ms
properties.description: Maximum recording duration (10 minutes). Hard limit to prevent unbounded capture.

properties.name: audio.capture.device-name
properties.description: Optional audio input device name. If not set, uses system default microphone.

properties.name: stt.vosk.model-path
properties.description: Path to Vosk model directory. Must contain am/, graph/, rescore/ subdirectories.

properties.name: stt.vosk.sample-rate
properties.description: Audio sample rate in Hz. Must match model requirements (typically 16000).

properties.name: stt.vosk.max-alternatives
properties.description: Maximum recognition alternatives to generate. Higher values increase processing time.

properties.name: stt.whisper.binary-path
properties.description: Path to whisper.cpp binary executable.

properties.name: stt.whisper.model-path
properties.description: Path to Whisper GGML model file.

properties.name: stt.whisper.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Maximum transcription time in seconds. Prevents hanging on long/corrupted audio.

properties.name: stt.whisper.language
properties.description: Language code (ISO 639-1). Use 'en' for English.

properties.name: stt.whisper.threads
properties.description: Number of CPU threads for Whisper processing.

properties.name: stt.whisper.max-stdout-bytes
properties.description: Maximum stdout buffer size (1MB). Protects against runaway process output.

properties.name: stt.whisper.output
properties.description: Output format: 'text' (plain) or 'json' (structured with tokens). JSON enables advanced reconciliation.

properties.name: stt.orchestration.primary-engine
properties.description: Primary engine preference: 'vosk' (fast) or 'whisper' (accurate). Falls back to secondary if unhealthy.

properties.name: stt.orchestration.silence-gap-ms
properties.description: Silence gap threshold in milliseconds for automatic paragraph breaks. Set to 0 to disable.

properties.name: stt.orchestration.silence-threshold
properties.description: RMS amplitude threshold for silence detection (0-32767). Lower values capture quieter speech.

properties.name: stt.parallel.timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for parallel dual-engine transcription.

properties.name: stt.reconciliation.enabled
properties.description: Enable dual-engine reconciliation. Runs both engines in parallel and reconciles results.

properties.name: stt.reconciliation.strategy
properties.description: Reconciliation strategy: 'simple' (prefer primary), 'confidence' (highest score), 'overlap' (Jaccard similarity).

properties.name: stt.reconciliation.overlap-threshold
properties.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity for overlap strategy (0.0 to 1.0).

properties.name: stt.concurrency.vosk-max
properties.description: Maximum concurrent Vosk transcriptions.

properties.name: stt.concurrency.whisper-max
properties.description: Maximum concurrent Whisper transcriptions. Keep low (CPU-intensive).

properties.name: stt.concurrency.acquire-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum wait time (ms) to acquire concurrency permit.

properties.name: stt.concurrency.dynamic-scaling-enabled
properties.description: Enable dynamic concurrency scaling based on system CPU and memory usage.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.enabled
properties.description: Enable automatic engine restart on failures. Recommended for production.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.window-minutes
properties.description: Sliding window duration (minutes) for restart budget.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.max-restarts-per-window
properties.description: Maximum restarts within the sliding window. Prevents restart loops.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.cooldown-minutes
properties.description: Cooldown period (minutes) after max restarts exhausted.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.probe-enabled
properties.description: Enable lightweight health probe for engines.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.confidence-blacklist-threshold
properties.description: Average confidence below this triggers engine blacklisting (0.0-1.0).

properties.name: stt.watchdog.confidence-window-size
properties.description: Number of recent confidence scores to average for blacklisting.

properties.name: stt.watchdog.confidence-min-samples
properties.description: Minimum samples required before evaluating confidence trend.

properties.name: hotkey.type
properties.description: Hotkey type: 'single-key', 'double-tap', or 'modifier-combo'.

properties.name: hotkey.key
properties.description: Primary key for hotkey. Examples: RIGHT_META, M, SPACE, F13.

properties.name: hotkey.threshold-ms
properties.description: For double-tap: max time between taps (100-1000ms). For others: min hold duration.

properties.name: hotkey.toggle-mode
properties.description: Toggle mode: true = click to start/stop. false = push-to-talk (hold).

properties.name: typing.chunk-size
properties.description: Maximum characters per paste chunk. Large texts split to avoid clipboard limits.

properties.name: typing.inter-chunk-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay between paste chunks (ms). Gives apps time to process.

properties.name: typing.focus-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay after window focus before pasting (ms).

properties.name: typing.restore-clipboard
properties.description: Restore original clipboard contents after pasting.

properties.name: typing.clipboard-only-fallback
properties.description: Use clipboard-only mode when Accessibility permission unavailable.

properties.name: typing.normalize-newlines
properties.description: Newline normalization: 'LF', 'CRLF', or 'NONE'.

properties.name: typing.trim-trailing-newline
properties.description: Remove trailing newline from transcription.

properties.name: typing.enable-robot
properties.description: Enable Java Robot API for keystroke simulation. Requires macOS Accessibility.

properties.name: typing.paste-shortcut
properties.description: Paste shortcut: 'os-default' (Cmd+V on macOS) or custom like 'META+V'.

properties.name: typing.clipboard-restore-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay before restoring clipboard after paste (50-2000ms).

properties.name: live-caption.enabled
properties.description: Enable live caption overlay. When false, no JavaFX initialization occurs.

properties.name: live-caption.window-width
properties.description: Width of the overlay window in pixels.

properties.name: live-caption.window-height
properties.description: Height of the overlay window in pixels.

properties.name: live-caption.window-opacity
properties.description: Window opacity (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque).

properties.name: tray.enabled
properties.description: Enable macOS system tray icon.

properties.name: threadpool.stt.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core threads for STT engine execution.

properties.name: threadpool.stt.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum threads for burst STT capacity.

properties.name: threadpool.stt.queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded queue size for STT tasks.

properties.name: threadpool.stt.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Idle thread timeout before termination.

properties.name: threadpool.stt.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix for debugging and log identification.

properties.name: threadpool.event.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core threads for async event handling.

properties.name: threadpool.event.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum threads for event processing.

properties.name: threadpool.event.queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded queue size for event tasks.

properties.name: threadpool.event.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Idle thread timeout before termination.

properties.name: threadpool.event.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix for debugging and log identification.
